a.text: Skadi does not recall how far she's walked.
She only knows that so long as what lies beneath her feet is solid earth, she does not belong here.
But she can only walk upon the land.
The land. 'Tierra.' The first Iberian word she learned.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Who's Rober?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Ah, that's me.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This is your food for today.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Ah, alright.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Also, Joni wanted me to bring this present to you.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Oh, these are my favorite flowers! Why didn't he come himself?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: He said he was working.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Coward.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If you're fine, I'm going.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Hey, hey, visitor, wait.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: He already paid.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: No, you're Skadi, the bounty hunter who came into the village recently, right?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I hear you've been doing a lot for us. I've been wanting to meet you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It wasn't anything major.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Sit down, Skadi. Eat something, it's on me.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Is there wine?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Will ale be okay?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Your accent's very strange, Skadi. You're not an Iberian, are you?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: How rare. We often have refugees pass through this place, but I've never seen someone who wasn't an Iberian before.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Visitor, where did you come from?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I came from the sea.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: The sea? You’re an Ægir?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: We have Ægir in our village too, but I don't think they're too different from us. Not like you. I felt the difference between us the moment I saw you.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I've heard them tell of how they all left Ægir and came ashore when my grandfather was my age.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Oh, yes. My neighbor is an Ægir too. I'll get her to have a chat with you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No need.
She once held such hopes, but when she saw the Ægir of dry land, she knew she and they were nothing alike.
Only the oldest of them still dimly remembered what Ægir even looked like.
She had nothing she could share with them, nor they with her.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Ah, Skadi, did you know? The village has been talking about you every day.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: When you arrived in the village, you gave everyone an awful scare. We all thought you were just fleeing here after other bounty hunters injured you.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: It frightened us. A wounded bounty hunter is like a temperamental beast.
Most creatures of dry land are frail, unable to harm her.
What harmed her were those who profess themselves the Church of the Deep.
They were fixated on her for reasons unknown. Moreover, they were clearly unlike ordinary Iberians.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: But now, they're all saying they've never met a bounty hunter as kind as you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Are bounty hunters usually bad news?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: We've had bounty hunters hiding in our village before. They were especially ferocious, and kept clashing with the villagers.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: So at first, we'd all discussed whether or not to drive you away.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll leave.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Don't! You've given us so much help these past few days. We're all so fond of you now.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: You can stay here as long as you like.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Or is there someplace you need to go?

a.text: Is there someplace I must go?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Really? Then are you going back home?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I know, I know, there're so many people who run far away because their homes have been destroyed. I'm so stupid...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No, maybe you're right.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Oh! The bell's ringing?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What's happening?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: The village's bell only sounds in times of emergency...

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Rober, Rober!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Joni, weren't you working?

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Hide yourself!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: What's going on?!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: There's a pack of monsters near the village! They've hurt some of us already! We need to hold them off!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Get down to the cellar and hide, now!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: O-Okay!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Skadi, you... you're not one of us. You'd better run.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: If you're scared, come with me. Our house's cellar can hide plenty of people.
Since coming ashore, Skadi has had a constant feeling.
This feeling gradually grows ever stronger in the wake of these occurrences. Violent, relentless, restless.
But she has never dared convince herself.
She dares not convince herself— that she is why the sea monsters come.

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: Eek! Noooo!!!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Quick, hide behind me!

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: Wh—What are these monsters?!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: I've heard tales! They're monsters from the sea!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Normally, they'd never crawl out to a dry inland place like this. Why would they show here...?

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: And so many!

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: What now?! It doesn't look hurt at all!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: ...They don't move that fast. Run, meet with the others!

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: Eek! They're here too!

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: No! Stay back!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Damn things! I'll take you with me!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Terrified Villager
steps.text: No! Nooo!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: With just a single sword... Skadi, you're so strong!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Are you going to stay and help us?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: You really are a good one!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Come with me.
When Skadi opened her eyes on the beach, she found not a single soul by her side.
Ægir. Abyssal Hunters. All lives on the line, flesh to flesh, blood to blood.
None of it seemed to exist.
Only the sounds of the waves and the wind stirred in her ears.
Countless times she tried to return to the ocean.
But every time, countless sea monsters would surround her, forcing her to turn back midway.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Out of the way.
At some point, as she was forced yet again to swim back, she even felt a sort of misperception arise within her—
That the abyssal infinitude of monsters were not pursuing her, but rather sending her off.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: (Ægirian) Why—must you come near me?
Once she became aware of the possibility she may never return to the sea, she had no choice but to turn around on the shore and set foot onto this land she'd never been concerned with before.
This land.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Skadi's incredible...

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Rober, what are you doing out here?!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I was worried for Skadi... and besides, she's come to help us. Shouldn't we at least help defend our own homes?

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: You're right...

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: Absolutely right!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't need help.
In her eyes, the people of dry land are by and large akin to the ones before her now.
Frail, melancholic, leading lives devoid of efficiency or any positive qualities to speak of.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Don't be like that, Skadi. We can't let you bear everything for us.

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: I'll go and help her! I don't know if I can hurt any of these monsters, but I can at least distract some of them!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: I'll help too!

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: Everyone, with Skadi!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: (Ægirian) I said—don't come near me!
But she is forced to admit. There are some points of intersection between them, where they can understand one another. In the emotional.
She can understand what circumstances lead them to feel what sentiments.
And it is exactly this that vexes her more and more. It is for this that she feels guilt.
But she cannot divulge these feelings to the villagers. She can only hasten the swing of the greatsword in her hand.

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: What's she saying?

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: Look, she's moving faster! I'm sure she's encouraging us!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Alright, watch this!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Get out of my sight, monsters!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Rgh...

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: Don't be scared! See how you like THIS, monster!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Appreciated!

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: We're all friends. It's only right.

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: They're scared! Keep going, everyone, let's drive these monsters out!

steps.name: Villagers
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Wonderful! I think the rest have run. I can't see any trace of them around the village anymore.

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: Heh heh. We're pretty incredible ourselves, aren't we?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: What are you so proud of? If it wasn't for Skadi, we'd probably all be done for.

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Hahah, just leave him be. We all made it through, so let him have this one.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Alright, alright.
She too once had comrades-in-arms, ones who fought alongside her, shared in the revelry of battle with her.
A vast number of them perished in that battle.
In the past, she was no stranger to sacrifice.
But as she watches the villagers share in the joy from the bottoms of their hearts, a thought suddenly comes to her—
She may be the very last Abyssal Hunter.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: What's wrong, Skadi? You don't look happy.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...It's nothing.

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: If you ask me, I bet she's hungry.

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I'm a little hungry too, haha!

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Enough of that. Still, Skadi, you saved the day today. I'll personally prepare a feast in honor of you tonight.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: And I'm sure nobody in the village is opposed to you becoming one of us, after you helped us in such a tremendous way.

steps.name: Brave Villager
steps.text: I was never opposed from the start!

steps.name: Panicky Villager
steps.text: No objections from me either! Hear hear, Skadi, stay in our village as long as you like, I say!

a.text: To you, the battle just now hardly registered as a warmup.
But to a village as weak as this, those monsters could easily have been the wave that drowns them.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: It's true, Skadi. With your might, we'd also feel so much safer if you stayed.

a.text: You don't belong here. You'll bring ruin to this place.

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: Don't you have nowhere to go?

steps.name: Friendly Villager
steps.text: You can live with us.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: No. I've decided now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If I can't return to the sea, then I'll go where there's no water.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hey, you hear about that Skadi business?

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Skadi? Don't think I have.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Something tells me your grapevine sucks.

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Fine, fine, I'm out of the loop, just tell me already.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Skadi's this Ægir who suddenly showed up out of nowhere a little while ago.

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Ægir? Where's that from?

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You... whatever. Makes sense a Kazimierzian would never hear about Ægir. I don't know too much myself, but I know it's a country and that's enough.

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Ohh... and? What's up with this Skadi?

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: She's got this giant greatsword, and you wouldn't miss her clothes from a mile away, but she's refused to ever work with anyone else. At first, everyone thought she'd kick it in the middle of nowhere.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: But she's not only been thriving, she's been stealing a lot of other people's work.

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Last month, 'Flamelung' announced he was going to sort her out. Guess what happened?

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: He drove her off?

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: No, she took down the entire squad he sent at her!

steps.name: Curious Bounty Hunter
steps.text: That's... Where the hell did she come from?

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Don't know. Got sources who say she showed up alongside a bunch of bounty hunters coming back from Iberia.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Either way, apparently it's got 'Flamelung' pretty goddamn fuming now. Me, I'm looking forward to the show.

steps.name: Taciturn Passerby
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Chatty Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Huh? Who're you?

steps.name: Taciturn Passerby
steps.text: Who I am does not matter, I'm simply curious. You just mentioned an Ægir. Where is she right now?
